title: Why is the 'Bachelorette' canceled? A guide to the Taylor Frankie Paul controversy
summary: Taylor Frankie Paul rose to fame on The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives, then filmed a season of The Bachelorette. But it won't air as planned because of resurfaced domestic violence allegations.
